source_commit_policy: All execution stages use one fixed clean committed source SHA captured before the event check; the confirmatory stage must use that same SHA.

stationary_law.terminal_age: partition each sampled A exactly; final substep is shortened and never rounded or extended

integrator.coupling: For a sampled age A, partition [0,A] into consecutive fine intervals of length 1/512 except a final shorter interval. Coarse intervals merge consecutive fine intervals in pairs; a final singleton is allowed. Each coarse translational and rotational Brownian increment is the exact sum of its matching fine increments.

assertions: pre- and post-reset records share a timestamp
event_check.failure: BL2; do not reserve or execute pilot

rng.derivation: SeedSequence([base_seed, case_code, stream_code]); construct one PCG64 Generator per named stream and case.
rng.trajectory_order: Case order is active then passive. Per case, draw all N uniforms once from the age PCG64 in trajectory-index order and set A=-log1p(-U)/rho. Process fixed chunks [0:32768), [32768:65536), and so on. Within each chunk and fine-step index k ascending, active indices are those with A_i>k/512 in ascending order; set dt_i=min(1/512,A_i-k/512). The translational stream draws shape(n_active,2) and the rotational stream draws shape(n_active,), then each is scaled by sqrt(dt_i). Draw nothing for inactive indices or coarse paths. Coarse paths use only paired fine-increment sums. Independent named streams make their interleaving irrelevant.
rng.draw_order: The vectorized ordering specified in trajectory_order is normative. Coarse increments are derived only by summing fine increments and consume no RNG draws.

estimators.K: q_i=|r_i|^2; m2=mean(q); m4=mean(q^2); K=m4/(2*m2^2)-1; delete-one trajectory jackknife SE
estimators.paired_mean: mean of matched fine-minus-coarse trajectory differences; SE=sample_sd(ddof=1)/sqrt(N)
estimators.paired_centered_or_K: matched fine-minus-coarse statistic with delete-one matched-pair jackknife SE

supporting_only.passive_r4: record raw E[|r|^4] with trajectory-mean SE; it is non-gating and does not enter projection or overall classification.

sampling.target: Project all 20 rows. If every denominator is positive and every projection valid, N_target_global=max(8192,max(all 20 projections)); run that same number of new confirmatory trajectories for each case.
sampling.confirmatory_data: new N_target_global per case; never N_target-N0

outputs.atomic_policy: atomic create only; aliases and overwrite forbidden
outputs.stage_sentinels: Before any stochastic draw, exclusively create and fsync the stage attempt receipt containing stage, plan SHA-256, and source SHA; never delete it. Attempt presence forever blocks repeating that stage. On success atomically publish its canonical output. On exception atomically publish the fixed technical-failure receipt with stage, error, provenance, and attempt SHA-256.
outputs.rerun_block: the presence of any pilot/confirmatory/failure/attempt output prevents the relevant rerun; failure blocks both stages.
outputs.confirm_authentication: Confirmatory execution requires pilot-attempt and canonical pilot presence, no failure receipt, exact CLI-supplied pilot SHA-256, matching plan and source manifests with the same HEAD, and absence of confirm-attempt and confirmatory output. No tracked Markdown or status commit may occur between pilot and confirm. Clean-Git is checked together with explicit absence/presence checks of ignored attempt/output/failure paths.

route_record.independent_reference: T-012 renewal/final-value and stationary moment-matrix solution
route_record.CRN: used only for mandatory paired fine/coarse discretization; no unpaired cross-method confirmation is claimed.

provenance.external_records: canonical raw SHA-256 values must be copied unchanged into the derived artifact and program status after execution.

overall.precedence: contradicted if any of 20 confirmatory rows is contradicted; otherwise unresolved if any is unresolved; validated only if all 20 are validated.

stop_rules: Event-check failure is BL2 and blocks pilot.
Any invalid denominator, undefined estimator, or projection above cap blocks confirmation and records unresolved pilot ineligibility.
Do not alter parameters, steps, tiers, estimators, seeds, or the plan after inspection.
No rare- or frequent-reset numerical sequence is authorized.
